prev_row.boundary_rationale: The unit opens where the scene turns from darkened lands into light, at כִּ֣י לֹ֣א מוּעָף֮ לַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מוּצָ֣ק לָהּ֒ (oshb:Isa.8.23, byte tier), rendered “But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.” (web:Isa.9.1) = oshb:Isa.8.23; the causal particle opening that verse recurs verse-initially inside the span at oshb:Isa.9.3 (= web:Isa.9.4), oshb:Isa.9.4 (= web:Isa.9.5) and oshb:Isa.9.5 (= web:Isa.9.6), so the seam rests on the turn from darkened lands to light and glory the verse carries, not on the particle. A fresh nominal subject then opens the following verse, הָעָם֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ (oshb:Isa.9.1, byte tier) = web:Isa.9.2, and the address turns second person at הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַגּ֔וֹי (oshb:Isa.9.2, byte tier) = web:Isa.9.3, continued by הַחִתֹּ֖תָ (oshb:Isa.9.3, byte tier) = web:Isa.9.4; the unit is read as one sustained declaration, not because no fresh subject or addressee arises — both do — but because the chain of causal ki-clauses that follows (כִּ֣י אֶת עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗וֹ, oshb:Isa.9.3 = web:Isa.9.4; כִּ֤י כָל סְאוֹן֙, oshb:Isa.9.4 = web:Isa.9.5) restates the same reason as the opening light and the multiplied joy, before the birth clause returns to third person, כִּי יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד (oshb:Isa.9.5, byte tier) = web:Isa.9.6, without a further break in the argument. The throne-naming clause reads פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ אֵ֣ל גִּבּ֔וֹר אֲבִי עַ֖ד שַׂר שָׁלֽוֹם (oshb:Isa.9.5, byte tier), rendered “His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.” (web:Isa.9.6 = oshb:Isa.9.5); an OSHB exegesis note sits at this same verse (oshb:Isa.9.5), single-witness apparatus only, never text bytes, and is disclosed rather than argued as content. The unit closes at the government-increase clause, which the letter bytes stage as a doubled ketiv/qere token pair לםרבה לְמַרְבֵּ֨ה (oshb:Isa.9.6, byte tier) — the ketiv form carries a final mem in medial position; the quote engages both staged forms, not one alone — rendered “The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.” (web:Isa.9.7 = oshb:Isa.9.6).
